title: StatementImport
description: data of POST /v1/statements. Personal data is removed before anything is stored (ADR-028). An unverified statement is still stored but not posted to the transaction ledger; a duplicate stores nothing new.

redaction.description: How personal data was removed from this import. Null for a duplicate: nothing new was redacted or stored.

rules.description: Version of the built-in rules, which always run, e.g. pii-0.1.

detector.description: Optional detector run after the rules (NL_PII_DETECTOR): none or azure_language.

degraded.description: True when the detector was unavailable and only the rules ran (see the REDACTION_DEGRADED warning).

counts.description: Placeholders inserted per code; codes with none are left out. Counts only, never the text they replaced.

ledger.description: Posting to the transaction ledger. posted = 0 and classifier = null when the statement was not posted (see the NOT_POSTED warning).

posted.description: Transactions this statement contributes to the ledger.

new.description: Of those, added by this import (0 on a re-import).

uncategorized.description: Charges whose category was not accepted.

classifier.description: Method and training-data hash that chose the categories, e.g. naive_bayes@3f2a9c1d04be.
